text:
elaine: Quick ask — can we assemble a tiny curated set of marketplace sample repos + Terraform snippets that prove compatibility on ARM instances (Graviton) and Ampere-based partners for the marketplace listing and reviewer tests? Goal: reviewers can boot and sanity-check in <10m. :clock10:

samir: scope question — do we need both hosted AMIs and container images, or pick one per partner?

elaine: Prefer both where possible. Minimal checklist: 1) terraform snippet that provisions instance (arm64) + security group, 2) a multi-arch container image or AMI + simple start script, 3) README with exact test commands, 4) small CI job that runs the smoke test and reports results.

ryan: I can own Graviton sample. Plan to add a tf snippet + GH Actions smoke job. Draft tf for sanity check:
```terraform
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_instance" "test" {
  ami           = "ami-0abcdef1234567890"  # placeholder, arm64 AMI
  instance_type = "m6g.large"             # Graviton (arm64)
  tags = { Name = "rw-marketplace-sample-graviton" }
}
```

partners-bot: CI triggered: marketplace-scan/marketplace-samples-graviton (workflow run id: 5421) :rocket:

samir: For Ampere partners we should avoid hardcoding instance types. Use an input var for instance_type and document recommended instance families (e.g., a1/m6g/ampere-family) + kernel boot notes. Also need to confirm drivers (aws PV vs ENA) match.

elaine: Good point. We'll provide two example tfvars files: one for "graviton" and one for "ampere". Also include a minimal Dockerfile for multi-arch images: 
```dockerfile
# multi-stage multi-arch
FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
COPY ./start.sh /start.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/start.sh"]
```
Build command in README: `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t redwood/sample:latest --push .`

ryan: I'll add a small verify script `verify_marketplace.sh` that: 
- runs `terraform apply -auto-approve` with supplied tfvars 
- ssh's into instance and checks `uname -m` returns `aarch64`
- pulls the sample container and runs it
Sample GH Action step: 
```yaml
- name: Run marketplace smoke
  run: ./verify_marketplace.sh --tfvars=graviton.tfvars
```

samir: We should also add a compatibility matrix file `compatibility.md` listing kernel, distro, AMI id sources, and test results per region. Helps marketplace reviewers.

elaine: Exactly. Timeline: can we have first Graviton sample + GH Action smoke by EOD Tue? Ampere follow-up by end of week. Owners: ryan -> graviton, samir -> ampere samples + compatibility matrix. I'll prepare a short publisher checklist for the marketplace team.

ryan: Ack, will open PR under `marketplace/samples/graviton-smoke` by tomorrow morning.

samir: I'll ping the Ampere partner contact and ask for recommended instance families + any prebuilt AMIs we should prefer. Will also add a note in README about SELinux/boot issues.

partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing deadline for Q2 docs freeze is 1779950000. Schedule your reviews.

elaine: Thanks — small, focused artifacts will make the partner reviewers' lives easier. Marking owners and I'll follow up with the draft checklist in this thread. :thumbsup:
